rca:flags.text: Reference .cnv was processed with datcnv only; alignctd / celltm / loopedit are not applied.

The .cnv holds the downcast only (15157 scans, 11986 kept after removing ship-heave reversals). Bottle (.btl) averages are taken at upcast bottle closures, so CTD-vs-Autosal uses upcast data while profiler-vs-CTD uses the downcast.
Niskin 3 (SA-427, ~202 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle +0.0106 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.006 PSU/m.
Niskin 15 (SA-429, ~79 m depSM, sal00): CTD-bottle +0.0410 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.016 PSU/m.
Niskin 15 (SA-429, ~79 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle +0.0104 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.015 PSU/m.
Niskin 23 (SA-431, ~9 m depSM, sal11): CTD-bottle -0.0121 PSU is more than 0.01 PSU from the median; CTD gradient there +0.057 PSU/m.
Autosal workbook header date is 2025-04-20 but the cast is on 2025-08-26; looks like a template leftover (not changed).
